basis: Existing diagnostic records and v1 training/validation progress only; v1 test evaluation remains deferred until all sessions finish
hypothesis: Choosing one of two independently discovered feature sets discards complementary signals. A bounded union can improve the cold-start program without additional model requests or feature re-reading.
changes_from_v1: Retain the winning feature matrix from each cold-start attempt in memory
Identify duplicate columns by actual values, preserve distinct complementary columns, and select at most 100 using the fixed learner and validation labels
Compare the union with the best single attempt; keep the single attempt unless the union clears the same validation margin
Reproduce the chosen union SQL on check seeds and audit leakage before publication
Keep v1 reuse model/tool caps, fixed learner, test-data boundary and full cost accounting
development_rule: Freeze this variant before running it; do not change the in-flight v1 source or discard its result
claim: Hypothesis only. No quality or cost improvement is asserted.
